how: Provision by name; OK if an existing volume matches capacity, capabilities, parameters, topology and source; source may be a snapshot or volume
notfound: ALREADY_EXISTS(6) if name exists but incompatible; NOT_FOUND(5) if content source missing
notes: Caps: CREATE_DELETE_VOLUME, CLONE_VOLUME, CREATE_DELETE_SNAPSHOT (snapshot source), MODIFY_VOLUME (mutable_parameters), VOLUME_ACCESSIBILITY_CONSTRAINTS. Unsupported source: INVALID_ARGUMENT.

how: Deprovision by volume_id; must succeed when volume or its artifacts are already gone
notfound: Missing volume returns OK(0), never NOT_FOUND
notes: Cap CREATE_DELETE_VOLUME. Snapshots must survive delete if plugin supports it; else FAILED_PRECONDITION with volume left unchanged.

how: Grow volume to capacity_range; OK if already at or above target; returns node_expansion_required
notfound: Missing volume NOT_FOUND(5); already-large target returns OK
notes: Cap EXPAND_VOLUME; ONLINE vs OFFLINE expansion rules apply; NodeExpandVolume required when node_expansion_required is true. OUT_OF_RANGE for bad range.

how: Return current volume info including published node IDs and status for volume_id
notfound: Volume gone returns NOT_FOUND(5)
notes: Alpha, gated by GET_VOLUME controller cap (value 12, alpha_enum_value). Not required unless cap is advertised.

how: Attach volume to node_id and return publish_context; OK if already published there and compatible
notfound: NOT_FOUND(5) for missing volume or node; ALREADY_EXISTS(6) if published but incompatible
notes: Cap PUBLISH_UNPUBLISH_VOLUME; PUBLISH_READONLY for readonly. Published elsewhere without MULTI_NODE: FAILED_PRECONDITION; attach limit: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED.

how: Detach volume from node_id, or from all nodes if unset; runs after node unstage and unpublish
notfound: Not attached returns OK; NOT_FOUND only if volume or node missing and not safely assumed unpublished
notes: Cap PUBLISH_UNPUBLISH_VOLUME. Text says OK when missing; error table says NOT_FOUND otherwise; both are normative.

how: Page through all volumes via max_entries and next_token; no consistent snapshot across pages
notfound: Invalid starting_token returns ABORTED(10)
notes: Cap LIST_VOLUMES; LIST_VOLUMES_PUBLISHED_NODES adds status.published_node_ids (must also support PUBLISH_UNPUBLISH). Duplicates or misses during paging are allowed.

how: Report free pool capacity for the given volume_capabilities and parameters
notfound: n/a
notes: Cap GET_CAPACITY. minimum_volume_size is alpha. Only generic non-OK error rule; no specific codes mandated.

how: Cut snapshot of source_volume_id by name; returns ready_to_use=false while processing, CO re-calls until true
notfound: ALREADY_EXISTS(6) if name exists for other volume_id; ABORTED(10) if op pending; missing source code not mandated
notes: Cap CREATE_DELETE_SNAPSHOT. group_snapshot_id ties to x.csi.CreateVolumeGroupSnapshot. SNAPSHOT_ACCESSIBILITY_CONSTRAINTS gates accessible_topology. RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on no space.

how: Delete snapshot_id; OK if missing; group members must go through x.csi.DeleteVolumeGroupSnapshot
notfound: Missing snapshot returns OK(0)
notes: Cap CREATE_DELETE_SNAPSHOT. Group member: INVALID_ARGUMENT(3); in use: FAILED_PRECONDITION(9); pending op: ABORTED(10).

how: Page snapshots by snapshot_id, source_volume_id or all; excludes snapshots still being cut
notfound: Invalid starting_token returns ABORTED(10); no code mandated for unknown snapshot_id filter
notes: Cap LIST_SNAPSHOTS. Does not report processing errors; poll CreateSnapshot instead. SnapshotMetadata alpha: x.csi.GetMetadataAllocated, x.csi.GetMetadataDelta (cap SNAPSHOT_METADATA_SERVICE).

how: Apply only the keys given in mutable_parameters; absent keys must not change the volume
notfound: NOT_FOUND(5) for missing volume; unsupported params INVALID_ARGUMENT(3) with no partial apply
notes: Cap MODIFY_VOLUME (value 14, not alpha). Callers may check support with x.csi.ValidateVolumeCapabilities. Relates to mutable_parameters on CreateVolume.

how: Stage volume once per node at staging_target_path with volume_capability; OK if already staged identically
notfound: NOT_FOUND(5) missing volume; ALREADY_EXISTS(6) if staged at path but incompatible
notes: Cap STAGE_UNSTAGE_VOLUME. Must follow ControllerPublishVolume when controller has PUBLISH_UNPUBLISH and precede NodePublishVolume. FAILED_PRECONDITION(9) if capability exceeded.

how: Undo NodeStageVolume at staging_target_path; called once per staged path after all NodeUnpublish; OK if not staged
notfound: Spec says not-staged returns OK; error table also lists NOT_FOUND(5) for missing volume
notes: Cap STAGE_UNSTAGE_VOLUME. Must return before ControllerUnpublishVolume. Spec conflicts: OK rule (line 2675) vs NOT_FOUND row (line 2707) for missing volume.

how: Publish staged volume to target_path with capability and readonly; OK if already identical
notfound: NOT_FOUND(5) missing volume; ALREADY_EXISTS(6) if published at target but incompatible; FAILED_PRECONDITION(9) if staging path unset
notes: Multiple publishes allowed for MULTI_NODE or SINGLE_NODE_MULTI_WRITER. Changing capability on repeat: FAILED_PRECONDITION. VOLUME_MOUNT_GROUP node cap applies.

how: Undo NodePublishVolume at target_path, deleting what the plugin created; must succeed per target before unstage
notfound: NOT_FOUND(5) for missing volume per error table; no explicit OK rule for already-unpublished path
notes: No capability flag, MUST implement. Unlike other RPCs, no explicit 0 OK wording for not-published; idempotency is the general MUST.

how: Grow node-side filesystem or block at volume_path after NodeStage or NodePublish; OK if already large enough
notfound: NOT_FOUND(5) missing volume; INVALID_ARGUMENT(3), FAILED_PRECONDITION(9), OUT_OF_RANGE(11) for unsupported cases
notes: Cap EXPAND_VOLUME (node). Required after ControllerExpandVolume when node_expansion_required is true. volume_capability optional; may skip FS resize for block.

how: Return available, total, used and inode stats for volume at volume_path; staging_target_path should be supplied
notfound: NOT_FOUND(5) if volume not present at volume_path
notes: Cap GET_VOLUME_STATS; if advertised, RPC MUST be implemented. Block-mode volumes may omit used/available and inode info.

how: Return node_id unique across plugin nodes, max volumes per node and accessible_topology; result feeds ControllerPublishVolume
notfound: n/a
notes: MUST implement when controller has PUBLISH_UNPUBLISH_VOLUME. SP must not expect more than one call per node. Topology uses VOLUME_ACCESSIBILITY_CONSTRAINTS.

how: Return whole-plugin capabilities: CONTROLLER_SERVICE, GROUP_CONTROLLER_SERVICE, VOLUME_ACCESSIBILITY_CONSTRAINTS, SNAPSHOT_METADATA_SERVICE, VolumeExpansion
notfound: n/a
notes: REQUIRED RPC. Same set for every instance of a vendor_version. SNAPSHOT_METADATA_SERVICE is alpha (spec.md:662-668). Gates x.csi.GetMetadataAllocated and x.csi.GetMetadataDelta.

how: Report plugin health and readiness; may verify config, devices and drivers
notfound: FAILED_PRECONDITION(9) when not healthy or dependency missing; no not-found case
notes: MUST implement. CO may call at any time and repeatedly; SP should document maximum safe call frequency.

how: Plugin-generated volume_id and snapshot_id, opaque to CO; general size limits: string 128 bytes, map<string,string> 4 KiB
notfound: n/a
notes: 128-byte limit covers volume_id and CO name unless overridden (paths: at least 128 bytes). volume_context map: 4 KiB. mount_flags total: 4 KiB. volume_id should be sufficient alone.

how: Spec mandates no storage location; identity must be derivable from volume_id; plugin chooses where state lives
notfound: n/a
notes: volume_context must be stable per volume and be passed back on publish and stage calls. NodeGetVolumeStats staging_target_path lets nodes keep less state.

how: CO should keep one in-flight call per volume; plugin SHOULD handle concurrent calls and MAY return ABORTED
notfound: Pending op returns ABORTED(10) per volume or snapshot
notes: Spec says CO may lose state and issue concurrent calls. No plugin-side locking is mandated; ABORTED is optional but named per RPC.

how: Create keyed by name, delete and publish keyed by id; replay returns OK when already in the desired state
notfound: ALREADY_EXISTS only for incompatible existing object; deletes never return NOT_FOUND
notes: Mandatory for Create/Delete Volume and Snapshot, Publish/Unpublish, Stage/Unstage, Expand, ModifyVolume. Reads and Probe are excluded. Replays must return the same IDs.
